title: Self-Supervised & Contrastive Learning
tagline: How models learn strong features from unlabeled data: contrastive losses, SimCLR, BYOL, masked autoencoders, DINO through DINOv3, and JEPA's predict-the-representation idea.
prereqs: Deep Learning and Computer Vision, including vision transformers. Multimodal & Vision-Language Models covers CLIP, the image-text side of contrastive learning.

steps.title: What self-supervised learning is
steps.why: Learn features from unlabeled data with training targets made from the data itself.

steps.title: Self-supervised learning in CS231N
steps.why: Stanford lecture tour from pretext tasks to contrastive and masked methods.

steps.title: Contrastive learning in five minutes
steps.why: The core idea: similar pairs close together, dissimilar pairs far apart.

steps.title: Contrastive loss
steps.why: The loss behind that idea, worked through step by step.

steps.title: SimCLR
steps.why: Two augmented views of one image should match; other batch images are negatives.

steps.title: BYOL: no negative pairs
steps.why: An online network predicts a slow momentum target's embedding, without negatives.

steps.title: Masked autoencoders
steps.why: Mask most image patches and train a ViT to reconstruct the missing pixels.

steps.title: DINO: self-distillation
steps.why: A student matches a momentum teacher across image crops, with no labels.

steps.title: DINOv2
steps.why: DINO-style training scaled on curated data, giving general-purpose frozen features.

steps.title: DINOv3
steps.why: Larger-scale training that keeps dense patch features useful for many tasks.

steps.title: I-JEPA
steps.why: Predict the representations of masked image regions instead of their pixels.

steps.title: V-JEPA
steps.why: The same feature-prediction idea applied to unlabeled video clips.

projects: Pretrain SimCLR on CIFAR-10 without labels, then train a linear classifier on the frozen features and compare it with a supervised baseline.
Use frozen DINOv2 features for k-nearest-neighbor classification on a small image set you collect, and plot the embeddings in 2D.
Show PCA of DINOv2 patch features as colors on your own photos, and point out where objects separate without any labels.
